business_change: Initial V2 input provides same-claim permitted complete-block occurrence tables for literal leading scope, technical identifiers, numeric/quantity words, predicate terms and explicitly labelled word-family lookup hints. Full claims, units, source blocks and allowlists remain untouched. checked.py passes its already-present full_aliased_fragments to the helper.

limitations: The three retained partials are one body claim and two short-answer claims. Their missing source contexts are now discoverable candidates; semantic support has not yet been fixed or proved.

Ordinary word overlap and English word-family collisions may add irrelevant candidates. The model must read whole predicates and unchanged full source blocks; hints cannot certify identity, polarity, conditions, numerical relations, aliases or continuation.
All 89 hint rows are metadata within original allowed bindings. Packet cost rose 11,121 bytes; actual whole-wire/token costs require Root's finite paired serialization and guard checks.
No actual model paired result, measured speedup, complete source support or p95 claim exists for this candidate.
The fixed experiment baseline must remain the original actual36 initial 10-claim/19-unit packet. Its accepted rewritten 10/21 packet is only a mapped reference, never the other arm.
